# Inbox, tabbed shell and verification codes: device re-check (fixed APK)

Run on the Boat sandbox `bx_bngcafgz`, 2026-11-22 00:10 to 00:45 Mountain (07:10 to 07:45 UTC).
APK under test: `/home/user/apk-under-test/tabs-codes-v2.apk`, sha256
`6973e4df6e994daad9b1d906498343137b986209da9e52f48c50fa680adee787`, version 0.2.6-alpha (code 11), application id
`ly.com.tahaben.farhan_alpha`. Earlier report: `research/inbox-device-report.md` (old APK, sha `fd2e22a7...`).
I changed no source files and made no commits. Screenshots: `research/screens/v5/`. Scripts: `research/emulator-v4/`.
Raw jank output: `research/emulator-v4/perf/v5/`.

## Summary

**Passed (all ten items, two with a defect attached).**

- Item 1: all five Settings tabs fit at once, none clipped, and the strip does not scroll.
- Item 2: Inbox has no title bar and no gear. The header is the two tabs plus `Clear All`, then the priority chips. The
  `Newer / Page 1 / Older` row shows with 300 rows and is absent on one page. Section headers read `N on this page`
  only when there is more than one page. The first row now starts at y=641 px (was about 810) with the paging row,
  and y=515 px on a single page.
- Item 3: the Cleared tab action reads `Empty`.
- Item 4: Clear All dialog has the new sentence. After confirming, the database has 0 live rows and the 12 seeded
  cleared rows (13 with one I cleared from the shade), and the Cleared tab still lists them.
- Item 5: the red note is correct and gives the exact `appops` command. After the app-op and a listener rebind, codes
  work end to end: Codes section at the top, dark filled Copy, only digits on the clipboard (`G-482913` pastes as
  `482913`), Farhan's own `Verification code` notification with COPY, `Your OTP to pay 2499 to Swiggy is 482913`
  gives `482913`, the numeric-title text and the password text are not raised.
- Item 6: Back from Settings lands on the Inbox. A deep link plus one Back leaves the app (one Inbox, not two). No
  stale app page after Settings > Apps > app > Inbox > Settings.
- Item 7: no `Clear budget spend (debug)` in Settings > Notifications.
- Item 8: the priority bar is grey with only Critical tinted red.
- Item 9: ticking a row, then dismissing its notification in the shade, drops the selection to 0 and the header goes
  back to `Clear All`; the row moves to Cleared.
- Item 10: Inbox jank median 8.61 % janky (earlier 10.47 %), software-rendered and noisy.

**Failed or defective (worst first).**

1. **The red "Android is hiding codes" note does not appear while the app is running.** The preference flag is set
   the moment the redacted text arrives (`notification_experiment_otp_redaction_seen=true` in `shared_pref.xml`) but
   Settings > Notifications keeps showing the old state. Leaving Settings, switching Settings tabs and re-entering
   from the bottom bar did not refresh it. It appeared only after a cold restart (`am force-stop`, start). A user who
   turns on Raise codes, gets a code and opens Settings sees no explanation. (New defect N1.)
2. **Codes written to the database did not show in the Inbox until the app was restarted**, once, right after I
   granted the app-op and toggled notification access. Both code rows were in the database (priority 1, Critical,
   delivered) and Farhan's `farhan-code` notifications were posted, but the Inbox showed no Codes section and an extra
   blank `Shell` row. After `am force-stop` and relaunch the Codes section was there; codes posted afterwards showed
   live. I saw this once and did not reproduce it on purpose. (N2.)
3. **A blank `Shell` row appears in the Inbox** for Android's own `ranker_group` summary notification (title and text
   empty, Waiting, Medium). (N3.)
4. **The "Hold Up!" dialog still shows on every visit to Settings > Notifications.** It was in the earlier report
   (Defect 9) and is unchanged. (N4.)

**Could not check.** A retail (user-build) phone: the app-op may not be grantable there, and this emulator is a
userdebug image. The exact 100/101 row boundary for the paging row (I tested 300 rows and about 58 rows). Whether the
shade dismissal of Farhan's own proxy (as opposed to the original) clears the row the same way. Lock-screen behaviour
of the code notification. The 'Only from' scope, the 'Raise to' picker and ten-minute expiry beyond noticing that
codes older than about ten minutes dropped out of the Codes section. The brief's deep-link command as written does
not resolve (see item 6), so I used the app's own intent.

## Build under test and device

- Emulator: AVD `farhan-notification-pilot`, API 35, x86_64, 1080x1920, 2 vCPU, 1536 MB, headless, userdebug image.
  One emulator at a time; I killed it at the end (`adb emu kill`, `adb kill-server`; no qemu process left). No Gradle.
- **Software rendering.** SwiftShader, as in the first run, so frame times and jank percentages say nothing about a
  phone. The sandbox was shared: `free -m` showed 13 to 14 GB used of 16 GB with swap in use, load average 3.3 rising
  to 6.5 during the jank run.
- Fresh install: `adb uninstall ly.com.tahaben.farhan_alpha`, `adb install -g tabs-codes-v2.apk`, listener allowed
  with `cmd notification allow_listener`. First run by UI: Skip Now, theme dialog (OK), first-run page (scroll, Next).
  No showcase overlay appeared this time.
- Seeded with `v4seed.py` through `adb root`: 300 live rows (90 Waiting, 70 Not sent, 140 Sent), 12 cleared rows,
  threads, long texts. I reseeded several times; the seeder removes only its own `v4-%` rows.
- Notifications Filter and Raise codes were off on a fresh install; I turned both on in Settings.

## Results by item

| # | Item | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Five settings tabs fit, none clipped, no horizontal scroll | **PASS** | `03-settings-features.png`: Features, Notifications, Apps, Focus, More in one row, each tab 216 px wide (bounds `[0,216]`, `[216,432]`, `[432,648]`, `[648,864]`, `[864,1080]`), labels fully drawn. After tapping More, Apps, Focus and Notifications the label bounds stayed the same (Features `[50,167]`, Notifications `[236,413]`, Apps `[506,575]`, Focus `[716,797]`, More `[938,1007]`), so the strip never moved. Features is the tab shown on entry and I did not tap it a second time. `06-settings-notifications.png`, `04-settings-features-after.png`. |
| 2 | Inbox header, chips, paging row, section headers, header height | **PASS** | `01-inbox-top.png` (300 rows): no title row, no gear. Row 1 is the two tabs (`Inbox`, `Cleared`) and `Clear All` at y 63 to 190; row 2 is the chips Critical, High, Medium, Low, All (204 to 330); row 3 is `Newer / Page 1 / Older` (342 to 467). Section headers: `Waiting to send · 35 on this page`, `Not sent · 18 on this page`, `Codes · 3 on this page`. First row card starts at **y=641 px** (earlier about 810, so 169 px less). With about 58 live rows (`30-inbox-single-page.png`) the paging row is gone, the header reads `Codes · 3` with no suffix, and the first row starts at **y=515 px**. The Cleared tab (12 rows) also has no paging row (`02-cleared-tab.png`). Chips present in both cases. |
| 3 | Cleared tab action reads `Empty` | **PASS** | `02-cleared-tab.png`, `33-cleared-tab-after-clear-all.png`: node text `Empty` at `[933,88][1048,167]`. Tabs are no longer squeezed. |
| 4 | Clear All dialog text, rows after confirming | **PASS** | `31-clear-all-dialog.png`: "This removes everything in the Inbox. Farhan will not send them. The Cleared history stays." (exact). Before: `live|308`, `cleared|13` (my probe rows included). After tapping Clear: `live|0`, `cleared|13`, `clearedV4|12` (`q.sh`, see commands). `33-cleared-tab-after-clear-all.png` lists the Cleared rows (`Cleared Calendar 0`, `Cleared Music 1`, `Cleared Files 2`, and the `Bank` code I cleared from the shade). Defect 2 from the first report is fixed. |
| 5a | Codes, app-op not granted: red note | **PASS with defect N1** | App-op `RECEIVE_SENSITIVE_NOTIFICATIONS: ignore`. Raise codes on, posted `bankcode` ("Your verification code is 482913..."). Inbox stored a row "Sensitive notification content hidden" (`12-inbox-after-blocked-post.png`). `shared_pref.xml` had `notification_experiment_otp_redaction_seen=true`. The note did **not** show in the running app (`13-settings-codes-after-post.png`). After a cold restart it showed: "Android is hiding codes from Farhan. On Android 15 and later, run this once over adb, then turn Farhan's notification access off and on: adb shell appops set ly.com.tahaben.farhan_alpha RECEIVE_SENSITIVE_NOTIFICATIONS allow", red, with the correct command (`14-settings-codes-after-restart.png`). |
| 5b | Codes section, visible code, dark Copy | **PASS** | App-op allowed, `disallow_listener` then `allow_listener`, posted again. `18-inbox-live-code.png`: `Codes · 3 on this page`, "Nothing is copied until you tap Copy.", red rail on Critical rows, code in bold, `Copy` as a dark filled pill. Row shows `Sent`, `Critical`. See N2 for the first attempt. |

Tapped Copy, pasted (`keyevent 279`) into Settings > Apps > Search apps: the field shows `482913` (`20-paste-google-code.png`; uiautomator `EditText text='482913'`). |

Shade shows "Verification code 555123 COPY" (`27-shade-before-dismiss.png`) and a group of three (`21-shade-code-notifications.png`). |
| 5e | `Your OTP to pay 2499 to Swiggy is 482913` gives 482913 | **PASS** | Inbox row code `482913` (`22-inbox-codes-swiggy.png`); `farhan-code` notification text `482913`; database row priority 1 `Verification code`. 2499 was not used. |
| 5f | Numeric-title text not raised | **PASS** | Title `262966`, body "New sign-in to your Acme account": database priority 3 `Category default`, `isDelivered=0`, no `farhan-code` record. |
| 5g | Password text not raised | **PASS** | "Your password was changed on 21 Nov 2026.": priority 3 `Category default`, undelivered, no `farhan-code` record. |
| 6a | Inbox > Settings > Back lands on Inbox | **PASS** | `23-back-from-settings.png`: after Back the top activity is `MainActivity` and the Inbox header (`Cleared`, `Clear All`) is showing; not the launcher. |
| 6b | Deep link, one Back leaves the app | **PASS** (command changed) | The brief's command (`am start -a VIEW -d app://ly.com.tahaben.farhan_alpha/notification_filter ly.com.tahaben.farhan_alpha`) printed `Activity not started, unable to resolve Intent`: the manifest has no intent filter for `app://` (the route is a Compose `navDeepLink`, reached by Farhan's own notifications with an explicit component). I used the intent the app builds in `BroadcastReceiverNotification.kt`: `am start -n ly.com.tahaben.farhan_alpha/ly.com.tahaben.farhan.MainActivity -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d app://ly.com.tahaben.farhan_alpha/notification_filter -f 0x10008000`. Cold start: Inbox showed, `dumpsys activity` listed one `MainActivity` record, one Back went to the launcher. ### Jank (Inbox only, software-rendered)

Same harness as before (`v4-perf.py`, 12 swipes of 150 ms, 0.35 s apart, `gfxinfo` reset after the first screen
settled), 300 live rows with the page of 100, filter on. Wiped and reseeded first (`run-perf-v5.sh`). Medians of 5.

| Run | Frames | Janky | % janky | p50 | p90 | p95 | p99 | Missed vsync | Cold |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 346 | 36 | 10.40 | 27 | 34 | 46 | 150 | 4 | no |
| 2 | 360 | 31 | 8.61 | 24 | 36 | 48 | 113 | 4 | no |
| 3 | 303 | 53 | 17.49 | 27 | 48 | 57 | 113 | 7 | no |
| 4 | 403 | 16 | 3.97 | 16 | 28 | 32 | 61 | 0 | yes |
| 5 | 381 | 14 | 3.67 | 16 | 29 | 32 | 89 | 0 | yes |
| **Median** | **360** | **31** | **8.61** | **24** | **34** | **46** | **113** | **4** | |

Earlier median (old APK): 258 frames, 27 janky, 10.47 %, p50 28, p90 44, p95 53, p99 93, missed vsync 3. Per-run spread
was 6.04 to 61.11 % then, 3.67 to 17.49 % now. Runs 4 and 5 are quieter (p50 16 ms) and both were reported cold; the
sandbox load average climbed during runs 1 to 3. The median improved by about two points, but with this spread and a
software renderer I would not call it a measured gain. "High input latency" was 461 to 614 per run and I ignore it.
The fixture differs from the first run in one way that matters: the header above the list is shorter (no title bar),
so more rows are on screen per frame.

## New defects and observations

N1. **Stale "hiding codes" note.** Repro: fresh install, Raise codes on, `adb unroot`, `post.sh bankcode Bank
    "Your verification code is 482913. Do not share it."`, open Settings > Notifications > scroll to Verification
    codes: no red note. Switch to Apps and back, or to Inbox and back to Settings: still none. `am force-stop` then
    start: the note shows. Cause (from the sandbox source `NotificationSettingsViewModel.kt`):
    `otpRedactionSeen` is read in `refreshAutomation()`, which does not run again when the service sets the flag.
    The Settings view-model survives tab changes.
N2. **Codes missing from the Inbox after rebinding the listener, until restart.** Repro (seen once): with the app
    running, `appops set ... RECEIVE_SENSITIVE_NOTIFICATIONS allow`, `cmd notification disallow_listener` then
    `allow_listener`, post two codes. Database rows exist (priority 1, `Verification code`, delivered) and
    `farhan-code` notifications are in the shade, but the Inbox has no Codes section (`15-inbox-codes-section.png`,
    `16-inbox-after-tab-switch.png`). After `am force-stop` and start the rows appear (`17-inbox-after-restart.png`).
    A code posted afterwards appeared within 5 seconds with the app in the foreground. Not reproduced on demand.
N3. **Blank `Shell` row from Android's group summary.** The database has
    `0|com.android.shell|2147483647|ranker_group|2000|ranker_group|Shell|||3|Category default|0|0` (empty title and
    text, Waiting, Medium). It shows as a card with only the app name and chips (`15-inbox-codes-section.png`).
    Probably any app whose notifications Android auto-groups can produce it.
N4. **"Hold Up!" on every visit to Settings > Notifications** until "Do not show again" is ticked, even with the
    filter on (`05-holdup-dialog.png`). Unchanged since the first report (Defect 9). It also steals the tap when a
    script taps the Notifications tab, which is how I met it twice.
N5. **Settings > Notifications shows a "Raise to" row and "Any app" switch even with Raise codes off.** On entry the
    box had `Raise codes` off and still listed `Raise to` and `Any app` (`06-settings-notifications.png`). Minor.
N6. **Brief's deep link does not resolve.** Not a defect for users (Farhan's notifications use an explicit
    component), but any test or `adb` shortcut that uses the URI alone fails. Adding an `app://` intent filter to
    the manifest would make it resolvable; I do not know whether that is wanted (it would also let other apps
    send the intent).
N7. **Codes disappear from the Codes section after about ten minutes**, as designed. The two codes posted at 7:23
    and 7:24 were gone from `Codes · 3` at 7:35 while the 7:26 and 7:27 codes remained. Noted so nobody reads it as a
    bug.
N8. **Pagination in the header:** with more than 100 rows the first row starts at y=641 px, which is still
    about 40 % of the 1584 px above the bar. The paging row (125 px) and the section header with its note (about
    110 px) are the remaining parts. On one page the first row starts at 515 px.

## Commands and scripts

Everything is in `research/emulator-v4/`. New or changed this run: `look5.sh` (screenshot on the device, `boat scp`
into `research/screens/v5/` and a half-size copy for viewing) and `run-perf-v5.sh` (Inbox only: wipe, reseed,
allow listener, 5 runs). Reused unchanged: `emu-start.sh`, `v4.py`, `v4seed.py`, `v4-perf.py`, `post.sh`, `probe.sh`
(not needed), `q.sh`. All sandbox commands went through `boat exec bx_bngcafgz --timeout N -- bash -lc '...'`;
the jank run was detached (`--detach`, then `--attach`). `$A` is the Android SDK `adb`, `$P` is

   -d app://$P/notification_filter -f 0x10008000                       # deep link (brief's command does not resolve)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""drv2/v4.py: small adb driver for the tabs-codes APK (written for this run; adapted from cls-perf-measure.py).

  v4.py ui                 print every visible node's text / content-desc and bounds
  v4.py tap  X Y           tap
  v4.py tapt TEXT [N]      tap the Nth (default 1st) node whose text or content-desc equals TEXT
  v4.py tapc SUBSTR [N]    same, substring match
  v4.py shot NAME          screencap to ~/drv2/shots/NAME.png
  v4.py swipe X1 Y1 X2 Y2 [MS]
  v4.py scrollto SUBSTR [N] swipe up until found\n  v4.py has TEXT           exit 0 if a node has this text/desc
"""
import re, subprocess, sys, time, os, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
ADB = "/nix/store/ar72p6i5qic73h6mcr1krkf376jj8d1d-androidsdk/bin/adb"
PKG = "ly.com.tahaben.farhan_alpha"
SHOTS = os.path.expanduser("~/drv2/shots")

def adb(*a, inp=None, check=True):
    return subprocess.run([ADB, "-s", "emulator-5554", *a], input=inp, capture_output=True, text=True, check=check, timeout=60).stdout

def nodes(pkg=None):
    adb("shell", "rm", "-f", "/data/local/tmp/v4.xml")
    for _ in range(3):
        out = adb("shell", "uiautomator", "dump", "/data/local/tmp/v4.xml", check=False)
        if "dumped" in out: break
        time.sleep(1)
    root = ET.fromstring(adb("shell", "cat", "/data/local/tmp/v4.xml"))
    res = []
    for n in root.iter("node"):
        if pkg and n.get("package") != pkg: continue
        b = list(map(int, re.findall(r"-?\d+", n.get("bounds"))))
        res.append(dict(text=n.get("text"), desc=n.get("content-desc"), b=b, click=n.get("clickable"), cls=n.get("class"),
                        pkg=n.get("package"), sel=n.get("selected"), checked=n.get("checked"), rid=n.get("resource-id")))
    return res

def center(n): b = n["b"]; return (b[0]+b[2])//2, (b[1]+b[3])//2

def find(text, nth=1, sub=False):
    m = [n for n in nodes() if any((v == text) or (sub and v and text in v) for v in (n["text"], n["desc"]))]
    if len(m) < nth: raise SystemExit(f"no node {text!r} #{nth} (found {len(m)})")
    return m[nth-1]

def main():
    c, a = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:]
    if c == "ui":
        for n in nodes():
            name = n["text"] or n["desc"]
            if name or n["click"] == "true":
                print(f'{n["b"]} {"C" if n["click"]=="true" else " "} {"S" if n["sel"]=="true" else " "}{"X" if n["checked"]=="true" else " "} {n["cls"].split(".")[-1]} text={n["text"]!r} desc={n["desc"]!r}')
    elif c == "tap": adb("shell", "input", "tap", *a)
    elif c in ("tapt", "tapc"):
        n = find(a[0], int(a[1]) if len(a) > 1 else 1, sub=(c == "tapc")); x, y = center(n); adb("shell", "input", "tap", str(x), str(y)); print("tapped", n["text"] or n["desc"], x, y)
    elif c == "shot":
        os.makedirs(SHOTS, exist_ok=True)
        data = subprocess.run([ADB, "-s", "emulator-5554", "exec-out", "screencap", "-p"], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
        open(f"{SHOTS}/{a[0]}.png", "wb").write(data); print("shot", a[0], len(data))
    elif c == "swipe": adb("shell", "input", "swipe", *a[:4], *(a[4:5] or ["300"]))
    elif c == "scrollto":   # scrollto SUBSTR [MAXSWIPES] : swipe up until a node text/desc contains SUBSTR, print it
        for i in range(int(a[1]) if len(a) > 1 else 12):
            m = [n for n in nodes() if any(v and a[0] in v for v in (n["text"], n["desc"])) and n["b"][1] > 650 and n["b"][3] < 1580]
            if m: print("found", m[0]["text"] or m[0]["desc"], m[0]["b"]); break
            adb("shell", "input", "swipe", "540", "1450", "540", "750", "350"); time.sleep(0.6)
        else: print("not found"); sys.exit(1)
    elif c == "nav":   # nav NAME : tap the bottom-bar item by its text, restricted to the bar (y>1584)
        m = [n for n in nodes() if n["text"] == a[0] and n["b"][1] > 1584]
        if not m: raise SystemExit("no bar item " + a[0])
        x, y = center(m[0]); adb("shell", "input", "tap", str(x), str(y)); print("nav", a[0])
    elif c == "has": sys.exit(0 if any(a[0] in (n["text"], n["desc"]) for n in nodes()) else 1)
main()
